provenance: Actual Electron renderer from out/renderer of the checkout this script ran in; synthetic sessions, review and second-opinion services; no real agent calls
checks: under the verdict, "Get a second review…", "Find unrequested decisions…" and "Results · 0" sit in a row that says they are billed per run; the results panel says none has run and closes
the review dialog names the reviewer and vendor, exactly what is sent with its size and cap, that nothing else is, the dollar cap, and "This is billed."
changing the dollar cap re-reads the preview, so the statement and the digest follow the number typed
picking the other vendor says OpenAI receives it, that Codex has no hard cap and a 10-minute timeout applies, and what its sandbox does not stop
an unmetered profile is refused by name, and the run button is disabled
Run billed review sends the previewed digest and the profile fingerprint to main, which asks again before anything is sent
each finding shows severity, confidence, its location and whether that location is in the diff, and is marked Confirmed, Refuted or Not sure
adding confirmed findings puts one anchored note per finding into the review notes tray, and says Send review puts them in the message box
decisions show risk, the checked locations, how many were dropped for citing code not in the diff, and add to the review notes one at a time
a reply that could not be read says "Could not read findings" with the reason, and shows the reply as it came
the session ledger lists both kinds with reviewer, cost or unpriced, confirmed/refuted/not sure, kept/dropped, and totals only recorded dollars
Send review puts the confirmed finding, cited "second review by Codex", and the added decision into the message box, and sends nothing
the decisions dialog counts the messages and plan items it sends, marks the same backend, and refuses another backend with the reason
the Spending report carries a Second opinions card: every run with its session, reviewer, cost or unpriced, and what came of it
